verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Titan is a FIDO/CTAP1 hardware key usable with Google Workspace/Cloud and other FIDO-compliant sites, but there is no documentation of specific Okta or Entra ID admin integration, nor any admin console or policy-enforcement mechanism belonging to Titan itself — the probe explicitly notes fleet/policy management is handled entirely by the separate Google Workspace Admin console, not by any Titan-owned surface. Missing for 10: documented Okta/Entra ID integration guides, evidence of IT-admin policy enforcement (e.g., 'require security key' rules) tied to Titan specifically.
